system: Azobenzene, C6H5-N=N-C6H5, has two distinct configurations about its N=N bond, cis and trans. The structures below are stationary points of its potential energy surface at omega-B97x/6-31G(d), taken from a published kinetic transition network in which every minimum and every transition state was located and verified by Hessian analysis.
ask: Which of the following describes this transition state?

files.locator: Landscape17/azobenzene/Conformations/coordsts_0_1.xyz（数据集按文件名记为连接极小点 0 与 1）

hypotheses.text: It interconverts the two configurations by inversion at one nitrogen: the C-N=N angle at that nitrogen opens towards 180 degrees within the plane of the fragment, while the other nitrogen keeps its bent geometry.
hypotheses.locator: 分类规则（题干给出）；结构见 Landscape17/azobenzene/Conformations/coordsts_0_1.xyz（数据集按文件名记为连接极小点 0 与 1）
hypotheses.reason: 只有一个 C–N=N 角张开到 160° 以上时才成立。

hypotheses.text: It interconverts the two configurations by rotation about the N=N bond: the two rings twist out of a common plane while both C-N=N angles stay bent.
hypotheses.locator: 分类规则（题干给出）；结构见 Landscape17/azobenzene/Conformations/coordsts_0_1.xyz（数据集按文件名记为连接极小点 0 与 1）
hypotheses.reason: 需要两个角都未张开、而且两环相对 N=N 扭转到 60°-120° 之间。

hypotheses.text: It interconverts the two configurations by concerted inversion at both nitrogens: both C-N=N angles open towards 180 degrees at the same time.
hypotheses.locator: 分类规则（题干给出）；结构见 Landscape17/azobenzene/Conformations/coordsts_0_1.xyz（数据集按文件名记为连接极小点 0 与 1）
hypotheses.reason: 需要两个 C–N=N 角同时张开到 160° 以上。

hypotheses.text: It does not interconvert the two configurations at all: it is a planar structure in which both C-N=N angles stay bent, so the motion is a rotation of one phenyl ring about its C-N bond.
hypotheses.locator: 分类规则（题干给出）；结构见 Landscape17/azobenzene/Conformations/coordsts_0_1.xyz（数据集按文件名记为连接极小点 0 与 1）
hypotheses.reason: 需要两个角都未张开、而且两环共面。

notes: Landscape17 只给驻点与路径，不给机理名称。选项中"反转 / 旋转 / 协同反转"是偶氮苯文献里对这几种运动的习惯叫法；本题的正确答案完全由题干印出的分类规则作用于已发表坐标得出，不依赖任何未引用的论断。这些名称用得是否恰当属 L1 人工核对。
C–N=N–C 二面角在某个 C–N=N 角接近 180° 时是病态的：定义其中一个平面的三个原子趋于共线，二面角会在 0° 与 180° 之间跳变，幅度远超已发表坐标的精度。因此分类规则先看角、再看二面角，并在有角张开时直接把二面角判为未定义。
该过渡态的两个 C–N=N 角实测为 115.941° 与 179.228°，N=N 键长 1.2190 Å（两个极小点分别为 1.2396 与 1.2447 Å），张开一侧的 C–N 键从 1.4275 缩到 1.3364 Å。
Landscape17 的偶氮苯部分用 OPTIM 计算，未套用其余五个分子"只保留 1 eV 以下势垒"的筛选；本结构相对反式极小点高 1.838 eV，相对顺式极小点高 1.256 eV（能量见 sources.json）。
